argv: Map, walk screen and motion polish
ops.body: - **The strip's numbers say nothing of the settings being up on the web** (`ReadyBar`'s summary, the ready screen's and the walk's; found by fix walk-strip-buttons audit 4, Nov 18): it sets `accessibilityState.expanded`, which react-native-web does not turn into `aria-expanded` (it reads `aria-expanded` or `accessibilityExpanded`). The walk strip's … sets `aria-expanded`; the numbers do not yet. A screen reader on a phone hears the state (unverified). [loop]

argv: Pause, then hold Stop; on another
the owner's half and half for Resume and Stop (fix walk-strip-buttons, decision 0220)
ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** on a walk, tap …, lower the settings, tap Pause, then hold Stop; on another, Pause, then Resume and walk on; with VoiceOver or TalkBack on, move to … and to Stop. **Expect:** walking, the strip shows the numbers, … and a wide Pause, no Stop; … opens the walk's settings and is read "Walk settings", expanded or collapsed; paused, Resume (orange) and Stop half each, no …, every word whole on a small phone; Stop is read "Hold to stop", its activate action stops at once; held, an orange fill sweeps across Stop and the replay opens; Resume records again (decision 0220).
